title: Product-null lemma: ℝ × (Hⁿ-null set) is H^{n+1}-null (parent step 3)
statement: For N, n ∈ ℕ and Z ⊆ ℝ^N with Hⁿ(Z) = 0 (Hⁿ := μHE[n]), the set Ψ(ℝ × Z) = {(t, x_1, …, x_N) : t ∈ ℝ, x ∈ Z} ⊆ ℝ^{N+1} has H^{n+1}(Ψ(ℝ × Z)) = 0, where Ψ(t, x) := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (Z : Set (Euclid N)), μHE[n] Z = 0 → μHE[n + 1] ((fun p : ℝ × Euclid N => (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons p.1 (WithLp.ofLp p.2)) : Euclid (N + 1))) '' (univ ×ˢ Z)) = 0
